---
title: "Schedule"
subtitle: "Five days, 09:00–17:00"
---

All five days share one clock. Each module is a 40-minute briefing, a 70-minute lab and a
10-minute debrief. Module B's briefing comes before lunch and its lab after it; the briefing
ends with two minutes to open the notebook and run its setup cell, so problems surface early.

{{< include /_includes/schedule.md >}}

## Warm-up and wrap-up {#rituals}

- **Warm-up (09:00–09:15).** Five questions on earlier material: 6 minutes alone with notes
  closed, 4 minutes with a neighbor, 5 minutes on the two most missed. Nothing is graded.
- **Wrap-up (16:45–17:00).** The room fills in the day's running results table, and lists
  what is still broken.
